identification: FName::StaticInit, named by its guard in the shipped editor at VA 0x10fd8b4f. It clears the 4096 name hash buckets and registers 3762 entries through AllocateNameEntry and FName::Hardcode. It then loads FNames.txt, shrinks the indexed table, compares names within each bucket and suppresses DevNetTraffic. LoadNamesFromFile and the flag and storage labels are descriptive reconstruction names.
